3029.title: Sidebar parenting refresh has a subscription timing gap
3029.rootCauseOneLine: A parent change emitted before the server registers the client's thread-list subscription is not replayed or reconciled, although the reported long-open recurrence was not reproduced.
3029.proposedFix: Capture subscription and changed-message timing on a natural recurrence, then close the gap with an acknowledged revision or watermark and a post-subscribe reconciliation refetch.
3029.caveats: Normal settled-page runs updated immediately. The durable stale state required a 2.5-second timing amplifier on the thread-list subscribe frame, so the original long-open incident remains unverified.
